dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0487 handles self-pay insurance receipt file creation for monthly billing.
evidence: COPY directives with .INC files (CPRCF041.INC, CPCOMMONSHELL.INC, HCM48.INC)
ASSIGN RECE41PARA style (GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL environment variable assignment)
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL
Fixed format, no IBM-specific extensions like COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly billing detail file creation for self-pay insurance (自費診療), part of JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCR0487 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates monthly billing detail files for self-pay/private insurance receipts. It reads indexed files for patient insurance information, disease names, and point/amount claim data, then formats and outputs receipt documents. The program handles new-style receipt formats with group diagnosis support.

notable_features: REPLACING clause used with COPY for parameterized copybooks
Indexed sequential file I/O (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED) for multiple receipt files
OCCURS tables for receipt storage (up to 99 entries of 10000 bytes each)
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial data
Newline constant defined as X'0A' suggesting Unix/Linux environment
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP (or possibly Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 133749 bytes total (3136 lines), so only the DATA DIVISION is visible; PROCEDURE DIVISION not shown but inferred from mechanical indicators (215 PERFORMs, 13 GOTOs, 6 CALLs).
